candidates.evidence: ADR-0160's 2026-08-16 amendment (ratified, GH #1032, verified 2026-08-17): a real incident where align-self:flex-start sized a turn wrapper to its content's intrinsic width, and once a fixed-floor child (ui-status-stream's 16rem-floor narration strip) rode inside that wrapper, the WHOLE composed turn (header, pending row, bubble) collapsed to ~16rem and hugged the left edge on a real column, instead of filling it — the wrapper's own width rule silently followed its narrowest child's floor, not the column. Fix: for the agent role only, the wrapper drops the 92% cap and flips to align-self:stretch; max-inline-size:none; the user turn (no fixed-floor child) is untouched. Re-checked 2026-08-17 (decision-watcher re-judge): no skills/*/references/*.md mentions this align-self/intrinsic-width-floor composition trap; component-patterns/patterns-table.md carries no general layout-composition-gotcha row for it.
candidates.plan: Likely component-patterns/references/patterns-table.md (new row, [incident]-marked per pack-writing-rules: 'a flex/grid item auto-sized to content (align-self:flex-start) collapses to a fixed-floor child's own min-width instead of filling the column when a fixed-floor component is composed inside it' -> use align-self:stretch + max-inline-size:none instead of re-tuning the cap) — make-pack's own placement judgment decides final home.

candidates.evidence: ADR-0197 (ratified 2026-08-17, GH #1092, built same-day PR #1097): the THIRD proof of the barrel-lazy-split pattern (dogfood-lazy GH#354 -> markdown-lazy GH#468 -> agent-admin-lazy ADR-0197) -- a public '.' barrel's STATIC class/tag re-export drags its whole module graph into every consumer's entry chunk regardless of use; fix = move static access to subpaths + add one memoized loadX() dynamic-import accessor on the barrel, gated by a Rolldown bundle-shape test. PR #1097 also strengthens the bundle-shape gate itself over the markdown-lazy precedent: agent-admin-lazy.bundle.test.ts's own comment names the gap -- a lazy accessor can still leak its arm into a STATIC SHARED chunk the entry imports eagerly (isEntry:false yet still loaded eagerly with the barrel), so 'absent from isEntry chunks' passes vacuously; the correct gated property is 'absent from the EAGER CLOSURE' (entry chunks + their transitive static imports), which is what agent-admin-lazy.bundle.test.ts's eager-closure computation (chunksOf's eager Set, walking imports) actually asserts. Checked 2026-08-17: patterns-table.md row 17 ('a heavy sub-component only some usages need -> lazy import() at the interaction point') is a DIFFERENT shape (internal lazy-import for an interior sub-component, ADR-0048's calendar-into-text-field-overlay) and does not cover a public barrel's STATIC re-export forcing bundling, nor the eager-closure bundle-test refinement; grep of every skills/*/references/*.md for moduleIds/bundle.test/rolldown/isEntry returns nothing anywhere -- both facets genuinely uncaptured.
candidates.plan: Two candidate homes, likely both: (1) component-patterns/references/patterns-table.md -- new row for the barrel-lazy-split decision rule (public static re-export -> subpath-only + memoized loadX() accessor), citing ADR-0139 cl.8 + GH#354 + GH#468 + ADR-0197 as the 3-instance lineage; (2) component-testing/references/test-craft.md's Built-output-proofs bar -- a row/note on the eager-closure bundle-test refinement (assert absence from the transitive EAGER closure, not merely isEntry chunks, or the check passes vacuously on a leaked shared chunk). make-pack's own placement judgment decides split vs single row.

candidates.evidence: ADR-0193's 2026-08-17 ratified amendment (GH #1077, verified via header + utterance) adds a SYNC READ surface scoped to the localStorage tier ONLY: SyncReadableStorageAdapter extends StorageAdapter with getSync/keysSync (per-verb mirrors of the async surface, same-tick reads over the SAME live backing store) -- rejecting a snapshot()-style warm-cache alternative as reintroducing the stale-in-memory-mirror failure mode this ADR's own base Alternatives already rejected. Also amends the tier's role: after this lands, NO module in app touches localStorage directly (memory-store.ts's hydration migrates off its own hand-rolled prefix scan).
